name: Ur-Knight (Risen Archetype)
body:
The ur-knight is a powerful zombie knight capable of excessive power at the cost of his own wellbeing. This ability to push himself to extremes also allows the ur-knight’s body to repair itself when given enough time or magical aid through negative healing.

Skill Ranks per Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Ur-knights are proficient with all simple and martial weapons. They are proficient with all armor, but not with shields.

This alters the risen’s proficiencies.

Extreme Effort (Ex)

When an ur-knight makes a skill check, ability check, or attack roll involving Strength, he can add up to a +1 enhancement bonus to that check. If he adds this bonus to his attack, it also applies to his damage roll. Using extreme effort deals 3 damage to the ur-knight for every +1 of the enhancement bonus he gains, up to a maximum of +1. This maximum increases by +1 at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

This replaces frenzy, greater frenzy, and potent frenzy.

Ur-Healing (Su)

Ur-knights are unique risen whose metabolism kicks into overdrive as they suffer. Each round, an ur-knight converts up to 3 damage he has been dealt into nonlethal damage. Nonlethal damage heals at a rate of 1 per hour per character level, and any magical healing restores an equal amount of nonlethal damage. Nonlethal damage that results from urhealing is supernatural and still occurs even if the urknight is otherwise not subject to nonlethal damage.

At 18th level, if the ur-knight is no longer subject to nonlethal damage, ur-healing becomes fast healing instead. At 19th level, the ur-knight can reattach body parts, as with regenerate, but cannot otherwise regrow them. At 20th level, the urknight can’t die as a result of hit point damage unless he takes positive energy damage while unconscious and dying. He can still be destroyed with effects such as disintegrate.

This ability replaces risen virology.

Maximum Effort (Ex)

At 3rd level, an ur-knight can push himself to his limits. When he uses extreme effort, the ur-knight can deal 1 additional damage to himself for every point below 20 on his d20 roll to increase his result by an equal amount. This does not affect the value of the roll itself, only the total (he can’t get a critical threat by taking enough damage to increase his attack roll from 17 to 20); nor does it increase his damage when applied to an attack. An ur-knight can use maximum effort once per day at 3rd level, plus one additional time per day at 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th level.

This ability replaces the social talents gained at the listed levels.
